inputs.name: uptimekuma_version
inputs.description: Tag of the Uptime Kuma image, such as "2.5.9" or "2.5.9-slim". Change image_digest with it.

inputs.name: image_digest
inputs.description: Digest of the image for uptimekuma_version, such as "sha256:e884...". Podman pulls by the digest, so a tag that moves upstream can't change what runs.

inputs.name: image_repository
inputs.description: Where to pull Uptime Kuma's image from. "docker.io/louislam/uptime-kuma" serves the same image, by the same digest, with Docker Hub's pull limits.

inputs.name: listen_address
inputs.description: Address Uptime Kuma listens on. The default keeps it on the host for a reverse proxy in front; "0.0.0.0" listens on every address.
